content: अध्यापकः [अधि-इ-णिच्-ण्वुल्] A teacher, preceptor, instructor especially of the Vedas; व्याकरण˚, न्याय˚ professor or teacher of grammar, logic <ab>&c.</ab>; भृतक˚ a hired teacher, mercenary teacher; ˚उदितः styled a professor. According to Viṣṇu-Smṛti an {%adhyāpaka%} is of 2 kinds: he is either an {%Achārya%} <ab>i. e.</ab> one who invests a boy with the sacred thread and initiates him into the Vedas, or he is an {%Upādhyāya%} <ab>i. e.</ab> one who teaches for livelihood (वृत्त्यर्थम्) See <ls>Ms. 2. 140-141</ls>. and the two words. [उपनीय तु यः शिष्यं वेदमध्यापयेद्द्विजः . सकल्पं सरहस्यं च तमाचार्यं प्रचक्षते .. एकदेशं तु वेदस्य वेदाङ्गान्यपि वा पुनः . योऽध्यापयति वृत्त्यर्थमुपाध्यायः स उच्यते ..]
